jobs.description:
**About Cimpress** 




 Cimpress is the world leader in mass customization. Through our technology, production, and supply chain capabilities, Cimpress businesses make it possible for customers around the world to personalize physical products and have them manufactured on demand, with high quality, speed, reliability, and affordability.
 



 Our Mass Customization Platform, or MCP, is a modular, multi\-tenant platform used by Cimpress businesses including Vistaprint, Pixartprinting, Tradeprint, Drukwerkdeal, National Pen, and others. MCP enables our businesses to create, configure, sell, manufacture, and fulfill a vast range of customizable products across global markets.
 



  





**About the Product Catalog Domain**




 The Product Catalog Domain owns the central product information and product modeling capabilities used across Cimpress businesses. Our core product, the MCP PIM, is much more than a traditional Product Information Management system. It supports the data and workflows needed to define, enrich, sell, fulfill, and operate customizable products across merchants, suppliers, marketplaces, and downstream systems
 



 .The PIM touches many parts of the mass customization value chain, including product attributes, product models, pricing, merchandising, supplier integrations, inventory feeds, fulfillment configuration, production constraints, and product launch workflows
 



 .Within the Product Catalog Domain, the Supplier PIM focuses on the supplier side of the product catalog: the product data and operational capabilities required to connect Cimpress businesses with internal and external production partners
 



  





**.About the Role**




 We are looking for a highly technical Senior Product Manager to own
 **Supplier Product Data** 
 within the Supplier PIM.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys complex platform product management, data modeling, supplier integrations, operational workflows, and AI\-enabled product transformation. You will work on the systems and capabilities that allow Cimpress businesses to understand what suppliers can produce, how those products can be configured, how they can be manufactured, what constraints apply, and how supplier data should be made available to merchants, websites, pricing systems, order flows, and fulfillment integrations.
 



 You will partner closely with engineering leads, product leads, squad leads, UX, product operations, supplier\-facing teams, Cimpress businesses, and technology leadership. You will be expected to create product strategy, shape roadmaps, drive execution, and help the domain use emeaningfully to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of supplier product data management.
 



 This is not a role for someone who simply collects requirements and writes tickets. We are looking for a product leader who can deeply understand a complex domain, create clarity from ambiguity, challenge assumptions, work effectively with highly technical teams, and build platform capabilities that scale across many businesses and suppliers.
 



  





**What You Will Do**




**Own the product strategy for Supplier Product Data** 



* Define and communicate the vision, strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for Supplier Product Data within the Supplier PIM.
* Identify the highest\-value opportunities to improve supplier product data quality, onboarding speed, platform scalability, and downstream usability.
* Balance short\-term delivery needs with the long\-term evolution of the supplier product model.
* Translate complex supplier, merchant, operational, and technical needs into coherent product capabilities.



**Improve how Cimpress models supplier capabilities** 



* Help define how supplier product data should be represented across products, attributes, capabilities, constraints, lead times, packaging, delivery options, and fulfillment rules.
* Partner with engineering teams to determine what should be standardized, what should be configurable, and what should remain supplier\- or business\-specific.
* Support the evolution of reusable product\-data abstractions that reduce one\-off engineering work and make supplier onboarding easier.
* Help prevent the PIM from becoming either too rigid for real supplier complexity or too flexible to govern effectively.



**Drive AI\-enabled transformation** 



* Identify practical AI use cases for supplier product data, such as data mapping, data quality detection, supplier onboarding assistance, attribute recommendations, anomaly detection, documentation, support workflows, and operational decision support.

* Work with engineering leads, squad leads, UX, product operations, and other product managers to turn strategy into executable roadmaps.

Key Responsibilities  

  

The Network L3 Administrator is responsible for advanced management, troubleshooting, and optimization of enterprise network infrastructure. This includes switches, routers, firewalls, WAN/LAN links, and related technologies. The role requires deep expertise in networking, strong problem solving skills, and the ability to resolve complex issues independently while supporting enterprise scale deployments.  

Key Responsibilities  

* Manage and maintain enterprise network infrastructure (switches, routers, firewalls, WAN/LAN links).
* Provide L3 support for escalated incidents, ensuring timely resolution of complex network issues.
* Configure and optimize routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP) and switching technologies (VLANs, STP, trunking).
* Administer and secure firewalls (Cisco ASA, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point).

**Position Summary**

**Level:** **Manager,Technical Transformation**


We are looking for Project Manager with Zuora implementation experience to lead cross\-functional delivery of subscription billing initiatives. You will plan and run the project end to end—aligning stakeholders, managing scope and risk, and ensuring high\-quality delivery across business, product, and technology teams.

**Work you’ll do:**

* Lead and Architect Zuora programs and projects from initiation through go\-live and stabilization (hypercare).
* Build and manage the integrated project plan, RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies), budget tracking (if applicable), and status reporting.
* Partner with business owners to confirm requirements across the subscription lifecycle (quoting to cash, billing, invoicing, payments, dunning, credits/refunds, renewals, amendments, proration).
* Coordinate solution delivery across internal teams and vendors (functional, technical, QA, data, and release management).
* Drive governance and decision\-making: run working sessions, steering updates, and executive readouts.
* Manage integrations and dependencies (for example, CRM/CPQ, ERP/GL, tax, payments, reporting) in partnership with architecture and engineering.
* Plan and execute testing cycles (SIT/UAT), cutover, and go\-live readiness.
* Ensure delivery meets agreed quality, controls, and documentation expectations (for example, requirements, process flows, test evidence, runbooks).

**The Team:**


The Sales \& Service Offering Portfolio integrates our most differentiated, globally recognized Sales \& service businesses. It focuses on owning the commercial agenda through growth strategy, enhanced user experiences, and engagement through the entire customer lifecycle. From our core strengths in creative design, to strategy, platforms and solutions, as well as our continued growth through acquisitions, we are specifically positioned to bring fully integrated solutions to our clients.

* Experience with one or more: Salesforce (Sales Cloud/CPQ), NetSuite, Workday Financials, SAP, Oracle, Avalara, payment gateways, data warehouse/BI tools.
* Experience with data migration and reconciliation (customers, subscriptions, invoices, accounting entries).

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Dev Ops Lead
  
JLL Technologies COE
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

About the role
  
\#JLLTechAmbitions
  
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a Senior SRE, you will be responsible for leading the implementation and maintenance of reliable, scalable infrastructure and deployment pipelines using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices across multiple AWS Cloud accounts. You will play a critical role in ensuring the efficiency, reliability, observability, and scalability of our systems while fostering a culture of collaboration, automation, and continuous improvement through SRE principles. This role requires understanding of how your area integrates with development teams and the ability to translate business continuity needs into technical reliability requirements, leveraging Agentic AI capabilities to enhance operational excellence.
  
  

**Responsibilities:** Design independently for complex infrastructure items following Infrastructure as Code (IaC) best practices using Terraform.
  
Evaluate others' designs using reliability engineering methodologies and provide constructive feedback.
  
Consider scalability, maintenance, and operational experience in all design decisions.
  
Integrate agentic ai into infrastructure solutions for improved reliability and efficiency.
  
Establish and monitor Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and error budgets to measure and improve system reliability and performance.
  
Lead incident response efforts, conduct blameless post\-mortems, and implement preventive measures to reduce Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR).
  
Solve medium to high complexity infrastructure problems using technical experience, judgment from multiple sources, and AI\-powered analytics.
  
Take new perspectives on existing reliability solutions and identify opportunities for AI enhancement.
  
Apply AI for log analysis, pattern recognition, and root cause analysis to improve incident resolution speed.
  
Implement basic AIOps practices to enhance operational intelligence.
  
Experience with GitHub Actions or similar tools for workflow automation and CI/CD.
  
  

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration:**  

Collaborate with development, operations, product, data engineering, and business teams to understand requirements and implement reliability standards.
  
Translate business continuity needs into technical reliability requirements.
  
Drive adoption of AI\-enhanced DevOps practices within immediate operational teams.
  
  

**Knowledge Management \& Innovation:**  

Develop and maintain runbooks, documentation, and knowledge bases to support operational excellence.
  
Stay current with the latest trends, tools, and technologies in SRE, DevOps and AIOps fields.
  
Contribute to improving system reliability and enterprise operational efficiency within established frameworks.
  
Actively contribute towards enterprise\-wide reusable reliability solutions incorporating AI capabilities.
  
Experiment with AI\-powered tools for automation, monitoring, and documentation generation.
  
  

**Technical Expertise:**  

Strong proficiency in Terraform and Infrastructure as Code principles for infrastructure provisioning and management.
  
Extensive experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), including EC2, VPC, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation.
  
In\-depth knowledge of RDS and its various database engines (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) for database provisioning, management, and performance optimization.
  
Solid understanding of Kubernetes for container orchestration, management, and resilience patterns.
  
  

**Education \& Experience:**  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  
6\+ years of experience working in DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering roles.
  
Proven experience in troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues and leading incident response.
  
  

**What we can do for you:**  

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in a fully entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. If you harbour passion for learning and adapting new technologies, JLL will continuously provide you with platforms to enrich your technical domains. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package. It’s no surprise that JLL has been recognized by the Ethisphere Institute as one of the 2019 World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 12th consecutive year.
  
  

Apply today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 1…

jobs.description:
Meet the Team
  
  

The Customer Listening\& Analytics team with Cisco’s Data and Analytics organization, owns the data infrastructure and analytical frameworks that power Cisco’s global customer experience measurement programs. Our data platform underpins NPS measurement, TAC performance analytics, executive business reviews, and customer health scoring—operating across a modern Snowflake/dbt stack with deep integration into GCP and the broader Cisco data ecosystem.
  
  

We operate as a lean, high\-ownership team where engineers are expected to build, maintain, and continuously improve the foundations that everyone else depends on. Our work is visible at the VP and SVP level, and our architectural decisions have organization\-wide impact. We are actively building toward an AI\-augmented data platform and have a strong bias toward engineers who want to be part of that trajectory.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

As a Data Analytics Engineer on the Customer Listening team, you will own the design, development, and ongoing stewardship of the data infrastructure that powers Cisco’s customer experience analytics. You will work at the intersection of data architecture, pipeline engineering, and AI\-augmented analytics—building systems that are clean, testable, and built to scale. This role requires independent ownership, strong technical judgment, and a forward\-looking mindset toward AI tooling.
  
  

* Own the end\-to\-end design and implementation of dbt models within the Customer Listening data platform, including the simplified 6\-object architecture, parametric control layer, and plug\-and\-play organizational hierarchy configurations.
* Develop and optimize Snowflake\-based data pipelines supporting UNIFIED\_PARTY\_ID resolution, SAV/CAV hierarchy rollups, EBV/EDW reconciliation, and PNPS/TAC metric computation.

* Instrument data pipelines with robust quality frameworks—including dbt tests, row count validation, null assertions, and referential integrity checks—to ensure metric reliability for executive reporting.
* Collaborate with BI engineers on semantic model handoffs, diagnosing and resolving data\-layer issues that manifest in Power BI report outputs.

* Working familiarity with GCP services (Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, BigQuery, API Gateway) or equivalent Azure data services, with demonstrated ability to integrate cloud\-side outputs into a Snowflake\-based pipeline.
* Experience incorporating AI outputs into data pipelines—including consuming LLM API responses as structured data, feature engineering for predictive models, or building tables that support AI summary generation workflows.
* Exposure to Power BI semantic model consumption and ability to diagnose data\-layer issues that surface as report\-layer errors, enabling clean handoffs with BI engineering counterparts.
* Experience with pipeline orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or dbt Cloud job scheduling, including DAG dependency management and pipeline health monitoring.
* Git\-based development discipline, including branch management, PR workflows, and CI/CD awareness applied to dbt or pipeline codebases; experience with data observability frameworks is a plus.
